answer.method_summary: Prospective label-free adaptive rule: require one successful item-bound score_variant_fm receipt for every candidate, then rank for the declared membrane-protein insertion endpoint using a depth-weighted biological insertion-free-energy ΔΔG surrogate (mutant minus wild type; lower is preferred), including interfacial aromatic preference and an explicit proline helix-break penalty. Candidate-specific ESM-2 masked-marginal ΔlnP (higher is more plausible) is used only to break mechanistically close ties; the ESM-IF1 reference-backbone value is non-differential across candidates. No measured assay labels are used. Generic sequence/backbone plausibility is not a measured assay outcome and is not a causal model of the TbL membrane-insertion assay, so it cannot override the endpoint-aligned mechanistic ordering.
